detail.longDescription:
Your AI. Your phone. Your rules.

OpenAlly turns any AI model into your own private agents — running on your Android phone, not in someone's cloud. No OpenAlly server ever sees your conversations.

Most AI apps send everything to their servers. OpenAlly keeps the whole engine — the agent runtime, your memory, your skills, and every message channel — on your device. When you talk to your AI, the only phone involved is yours.

🧠 BRING YOUR OWN AI
Connect the model you want, your way:
• Your API key — Anthropic (Claude), OpenAI (GPT), Google Gemini, OpenRouter, Amazon Bedrock, NVIDIA.
• A plan you already pay for — sign in with ChatGPT, Gemini, or GitHub Copilot. No second bill.
• Your own machine — Ollama or any OpenAI-compatible server.
Eleven providers built in, plus any OpenAI-compatible model. Switch the brain anytime; your agents and setup keep working.

💬 ONE AI ACROSS YOUR MESSAGING APPS
Your agents show up where you already chat — 12 channels: WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Slack, Signal, LINE, Google Chat, Mattermost, Nextcloud Talk, Zalo, Twitch, and iMessage (with a Mac). Give each channel its own agent, approve who's allowed to talk to it, and reply in any language. (More channels on the way.)

🤖 A TEAM OF AGENTS, NOT ONE BOT
Build as many agents as you need — each with its own model, personality, knowledge, and guardrails. Hand your main agent a big job and watch it split the work across specialists, then bring it back as one clean answer.

📲 IT DOES THINGS, NOT JUST CHAT
• App Automations: show it a phone task once — book a ride, post an update — and it replays hands-free. It self-heals when the screen changes and hands control back to you at logins and payments. It never pays, and never sees your password.
• Web automation, scheduled tasks and reminders that fire back into your chat, an on-device Python runtime, and an App Builder that builds real little web apps just by chatting.

🛠️ ON-DEVICE MINI-APPS (15 built-in skills in all)
• SMS Analyser — your texts become spending insights, bill reminders, and scam/phishing warnings, all on-device.
• Voice Notes — record, transcribe, and summarize on your phone, then share a clean card.
• Flare — turn notifications into AI actions: auto-reply, summarize, log.
• Knowledge Base — drop in PDFs, pages, and notes, and ask.

📱 FULL PHONE CONTROL WITH ASTER
Pair the Aster companion and your AI gets real device access — calls, SMS, camera, notifications, files, location, mic — over a secure local connection. Owner-only, and you grant each power.

🛡️ BUILT SO WE CAN'T PEEK
• No OpenAlly server processes or stores your chats.
• API keys sealed in your phone's secure hardware (Android Keystore, AES-256).
• Optional backup is end-to-end encrypted on your phone before it touches your own Google Drive — locked with a 12-word recovery code only you ever see.
• You approve who can message your AI; risky actions pause for your OK; banking and payment apps are blocked from automation by default.

Free to start, ad-supported (Google AdMob), with anonymous crash reports — never your conversations. Android only today.

OpenAlly — AI for the rest of us.
